0022600151.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (3-2, 0-2 on the road, lost their last game) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-4, 1-2 at home, lost their last game) in the sixth game of the 2026-27 season for Cleveland, which sits 2nd in the Central, 1 game back, and 6th in the East, while Milwaukee is 5th in the Central, 3 games back, and 14th in the East. Cleveland will be without Jaylon Tyson, who is out with an ankle sprain, and Meleek Thomas is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 123-116 win in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
